assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a single premium 2D in-game chat sticker for the tropical multiplayer sports game "WhatTheFish".
Primary request: an adorable expressive orange-coral fish mascot celebrating good teamwork, smiling joyfully with big glossy navy eyes, cream muzzle and belly, short rounded orange fins, three simple coral dorsal fin lobes, small cheek blush, thick clean dark teal contour, confident geometric silhouette. One flipper raised in a cheering pose. A small mint sports headband with no logo. Exactly two tiny golden sparkle accents. Below its face a bold compact cream sticker-word badge with exact text "GGWP" in chunky dark-teal uppercase letters, one line, very legible at small scale.
Style/medium: polished professional 2D mobile game emoji art, crisp vector-like filled shapes, smooth controlled cel shading, tasteful subtle gradients, beautiful expressive face. Consistent intentional line weight. Not a 3D render, not hand-drawn, not sketchy, not painterly, no texture.
Composition: one isolated sticker, square canvas, centered, silhouette fills 80% of canvas, 10% transparent padding, complete uncut silhouette, continuous thick warm-white die-cut outline around fish and text badge with a very subtle dark outer edge. A unified compact icon, no background scenery.
Color palette: coral orange #FF975D, cream #FFF6DE, deep teal #173C47, aqua mint #68D4C5, golden #FFD477.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background; exactly one fish; exactly the text GGWP, no extra labels, no watermark, no border around the canvas; no hands or human fingers. Cute and friendly premium game-quality collectible sticker.
